summary: Delft University of Technology (TU Delft) is dutch university, founded in 1842. Type: public sector / education / research. About 5,421 employees (Wikidata). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 97% of its 34 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

culture.text: Strongest fields among staff are architecture, mechanical engineering, physics and electrical engineering.
Describes itself as an open international community with multidisciplinary teamwork, working on climate, energy, cities, digital society and health.
A big employer: about 9,928 people on LinkedIn, and it says it educates nearly half of all Dutch science and engineering students.

open.text: It is not listed in the IND recognised sponsor data we hold.
Says it trains engineers from all over the world.

growth.text: Staff grew from 4,754 in 2015 to 5,421 in 2018; LinkedIn now lists about 9,928 people.
Launched a new bachelor programme in Health and Technology.
A new €93 million tram line (route 19) now runs to the TU Delft campus.

worth_knowing.text: Moved student data and medical records to a US contractor's cloud despite warnings.
Adopted a policy on ongoing projects involving Israeli parties.
